_comment: Work-unit classification rules. Demo defaults, not business truth --
calibrate from historical pick/pack times later (docs/10 section 2).
Bands match docs/07: Simple 1.0, Moderate 1.5, Complex 2.0, Heavy 2.5.
Edit this file to retune; no code change and no deploy of new logic.
stage_weights is the share of an order's total work each lifecycle step
costs, in ORDER_LIFECYCLE order: PENDING->PICKING, PICKING->PACKED,
PACKED->READY, READY->DISPATCHED. Must sum to 1.0. Equal by default so
introducing this key changes no derived throughput figure by construction
(see app/routers/events.py and app/repository.py); retune once real
arrival_shapes and segment_mix describe the observed mix of incoming
SEGMENTS: they shape projected future arrivals (app/projection.py) so a
PROJ- order carries the same attributes -- item_count, segment, and a
work_units figure classify() itself would produce -- a real order does.
